title: The Great Maze Scramble
tagline: Three villains. One wobbly Compass Core. Zero pancakes left.
synopsis: When the Compass Core at the heart of the Mazeverse starts to wobble, three villains try to scramble every path at once. Super Zayd splits the Maze Guardians across the Mazeverse — from a robo-beast rampage in Neon City to a wave ride across the Grape-Jelly Dunes and a snowball showdown in the Frost Fields.
ageNote: Made for readers of all ages. Bonks, boings and splashes only — nobody gets hurt.

cover.alt: Issue 1 cover: Super Zayd front and centre with Dragoncrest, Arrowlight, Bubbleguard and Zigzag, while Grumblejaw, Blizzardbyte and Splashfang loom behind them

panels.alt: Dawn over Lighthouse HQ in the middle of a glowing maze. Super Zayd waves; Zigzag balances a tall stack of pancakes.
panels.caption: The Mazeverse: a giant, glowing maze where every path shines — as long as the Compass Core keeps spinning.

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: Quiet morning, Guardians. Too quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Zigzag
dialogue.text: That's because I already ate everybody's pancakes.

panels.alt: Inside headquarters a big maze map flashes three red warning signs and an alarm burst reads WEE-OO! Zayd points at the map; Dragoncrest looks worried.

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: The Compass Core is wobbling! Three zones are going haywire at once!

dialogue.speaker: Flicker
dialogue.text: Was it us?

dialogue.speaker: Flame
dialogue.text: It was YOU.

dialogue.speaker: Fluff
dialogue.text: It was the cat.

panels.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: a giant grey robo-beast roars and crashes beside a tall tower while tiny people below shout 'Yikes!'
panels.caption: Neon City, 8:02 a.m. Grumblejaw the Robo-Beast has arrived — and he did NOT wipe his feet.

dialogue.speaker: Grumblejaw
dialogue.text: ROOOAR! Every road leads to MY junkyard now!

dialogue.speaker: Neon City kids
dialogue.text: Yikes!

panels.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: Dragoncrest, with three green dragons on his helmet, stretches his arm far across the page and bonks a Glitchling into the air, while two Glitchlings with swords shout 'Attack!'
panels.caption: Grumblejaw brought friends: a gang of Glitchlings with foam pool-noodle swords.

dialogue.speaker: Glitchlings
dialogue.text: ATTAAACK!!

dialogue.speaker: Dragoncrest
dialogue.text: Stretch-Punch — around the corner… special delivery!

dialogue.speaker: Flying Glitchling
dialogue.text: Ahhhh!

panels.alt: Hand-drawn sketch, second take: the same Stretch-Punch from a slightly different angle, with the Glitchling flying off again
panels.caption: INSTANT REPLAY! That was so awesome, we're showing it twice. (Don't worry — Glitchlings are made of jelly code. They bounce.)

dialogue.speaker: Flying Glitchling
dialogue.text: Ahhhh! …again!

panels.alt: Zayd's eyes glow gold as Maze-Sight lights up dotted golden paths across a purple maze, leading to an ice zone and a sea zone

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: Grumblejaw is only the distraction! The real trouble is in the Splash Sea and the Frost Fields.

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: Zigzag, take the sea. Bubbleguard and Arrowlight, the snow. Dragoncrest — you're with me!

panels.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: four little heroes ride along the back of a blue sea serpent on a big wave above purple sand, under a crescent moon
panels.caption: Meanwhile, over the Grape-Jelly Dunes… Splashfang sends a giant wave to wash the paths away.

dialogue.speaker: Zigzag
dialogue.text: SURF'S UP!

dialogue.speaker: Splashfang
dialogue.text: Hey! I am NOT a surfboard!

panels.alt: Hand-drawn sketch: under a yellow sun, the team faces a giant labelled 'Yeti' in the snow — an archer with a blue bow, a hero in a blue shield, a speedster with zigzag legs and more, with icy puddles below
panels.caption: The Frost Fields. Blizzardbyte the Glitch Yeti has frozen every path into a slippery ice maze.

dialogue.speaker: Blizzardbyte
dialogue.text: Nobody escapes my ice maze! Brrr-ha-ha!

dialogue.speaker: Arrowlight
dialogue.text: Good thing we're not trying to escape. We're trying to WIN.

panels.alt: Bubbleguard holds up a giant bubble that bounces snowballs back toward a surprised yeti, under a pink burst that reads BOING!

dialogue.speaker: Bubbleguard
dialogue.text: Bubble up! Return to sender!

dialogue.speaker: Blizzardbyte
dialogue.text: My own snowballs?! That's… actually pretty fair.

panels.alt: Arrowlight fires a glowing light-bridge over a dark chasm. Zayd and Dragoncrest race across toward the Compass Core, which has three Scramble Magnets stuck to it.
panels.caption: At the heart of the maze, the villains have stuck three Scramble Magnets onto the Compass Core.

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: Ready? We pull them off on three!

dialogue.speaker: Dragoncrest
dialogue.text: ON three… or AFTER three?

panels.alt: The Compass Core blazes back to life under a red burst that reads KA-WHOOMP!, and the three villains go tumbling away into the distance

dialogue.speaker: Grumblejaw
dialogue.text: This isn't over, Maze Guardians! …Which way is home?

dialogue.speaker: Super Zayd
dialogue.text: Left, left, right — and wipe your feet this time!

panels.alt: Sunset group pose of all five Maze Guardians in front of a giant sun, while a cracked mirror glints in the corner
panels.caption: The Mazeverse is safe… for now. But deep beneath the maze, a mirror has started to crack…

dialogue.speaker: Zigzag
dialogue.text: Victory pancakes?

dialogue.speaker: Everyone
dialogue.text: VICTORY PANCAKES!

nextIssue.title: The Mirror Maze
nextIssue.teaser: What happens when the Guardians meet… themselves? Coming soon.
